title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Update Payment Method
content:
Users can update their payment method via the app > 'My Account' > 'Payment Settings'.

- Supported methods: credit card, debit card
- The new method is used from the next billing cycle
- If a payment failed, ask the user to update the card and the system will retry automatically within 24 hours

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your payment method anytime in the CultPass app under 'My Account' > 'Payment Settings'. The new card will be used for your next billing cycle."

title: Unexpected or Duplicate Charges
content:
If a user reports an unexpected charge:

- Ask them to check the billing history in the app > 'My Account' > 'Billing History'
- Explain that the subscription renews automatically on the same date each month
- Premium event fees are charged separately at the time of reservation
- If the user was charged twice for the same period, escalate to human support (billing team)

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can review all charges under 'My Account' > 'Billing History'. Your subscription renews monthly, and premium event fees are charged separately. If you see a duplicate charge, we'll forward this to our billing team right away."

title: Refund Policy
content:
CultPass subscriptions are generally non-refundable:

- Monthly fees already charged are not refunded, even if experiences were not used
- Premium event fees can be refunded only if the event is canceled by the venue
- Any other refund request must be escalated to the support lead for approval
- Do NOT promise a refund to the user

**Suggested phrasing:**
"CultPass subscription fees are non-refundable. If a premium event is canceled by the venue, the extra fee will be refunded. For other cases, I'll forward your request to our team for review."

title: How to Update Profile or Email Address
content:
Users can edit their profile via the app > 'My Account' > 'Profile'.

- Name and phone number can be changed directly
- To change the email address, a confirmation link is sent to the new email
- The change is completed after the user clicks the link
- If the user no longer has access to the old email and cannot log in, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your profile in 'My Account' > 'Profile'. When you change your email, we'll send a confirmation link to the new address. The change is applied once you click it."

title: How to Delete an Account
content:
Users can request account deletion via the app > 'My Account' > 'Delete Account'.

- The active subscription must be canceled first
- Deletion removes reservations and history and cannot be undone
- Requests for full personal data deletion or data export must be escalated to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can delete your account in 'My Account' > 'Delete Account' after canceling your subscription. Please note this action cannot be undone."

title: App Crashes or Won't Load
content:
If the CultPass app crashes or does not load:

- Ask the user to close and restart the app
- Make sure the app is updated to the latest version
- Check the internet connection
- If the problem continues, uninstall and reinstall the app (account data is saved in the cloud)
- If the app still crashes after reinstalling, escalate to human support with the device model and OS version

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please try restarting the app and make sure it's updated to the latest version. If it still doesn't work, reinstalling the app usually fixes the issue. Your account data won't be lost."

title: QR Code Not Working at the Venue
content:
If the QR code cannot be scanned at the venue:

- Ask the user to increase screen brightness
- Check that the reservation status is 'Confirmed' in the app > 'My Reservations'
- QR codes are available offline once the reservation is confirmed
- Show the QR code from the reservation screen, not a screenshot
- If the reservation is confirmed but the code is still rejected, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please turn up your screen brightness and open the QR code from 'My Reservations' instead of using a screenshot. Also check that your reservation shows as 'Confirmed'."

title: Not Receiving Emails or Notifications
content:
If a user does not receive emails or push notifications:

- Check the spam or promotions folder for emails
- Confirm the registered email address in 'My Account' > 'Profile'
- For push notifications, check that notifications are enabled for CultPass in the phone settings
- Also check the app > 'Settings' > 'Notifications'

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please check your spam folder and confirm your email in 'My Account' > 'Profile'. For push notifications, make sure they're enabled for CultPass in both your phone settings and the app settings."

title: How to Cancel or Change a Reservation
content:
Users can manage reservations via the app > 'My Reservations'.

- Cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the event; the experience credit is returned
- Cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows use up one experience credit
- To change the date, cancel the current reservation and book a new one
- Premium event fees follow the Refund Policy

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel a reservation in 'My Reservations'. If you cancel at least 24 hours before the event, your experience credit will be returned. Later cancellations or no-shows will use one credit."

title: Unused Monthly Experiences (Rollover)
content:
Each month, users receive 4 experience credits:

- Unused credits do NOT roll over to the next month
- Credits reset on the subscription renewal date
- Users can check remaining credits in the app > 'My Account' > 'My Plan'

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your 4 monthly experiences reset on your renewal date, and unused ones don't carry over. You can check how many you have left in 'My Account' > 'My Plan'."
